text: I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it, but God, who set me apart before I was born, was pleased to reveal his Son to me.
The believers still fear you, Paul, and the temple guard has marked this house. Stand ready, all of you.
Set apart for the work to which the Spirit has called us, we go now to the Gentiles who have never heard his name.
Antioch has welcomed us with open arms, Paul, but Roman informers watch every door where 'Christians' gather.
About midnight, chained in the inner cell, we prayed and sang hymns to God, and the prisoners listened.
They stripped us and beat us with rods, Paul. My back is raw, but my spirit will not break.
I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
The believers here quarrel over who baptized them, Paul - some say yours, some Apollos's, some Peter's.
I fought as if facing wild beasts in this city's arena, for the sake of the gospel.
Demetrius has stirred the silversmiths into a mob, Paul - they shout for Artemis in the streets and mean us harm.
(Slips toward the Forum) I have loved this present world too much, Paul. Rome's favor is worth more to me than your chains.
Demas, are you turning from the faith for the sake of Rome's gold?
Demas, how could you do this? We trusted you.
This is a dark hour for us all. We must stay strong.
We must not let this desertion break our spirits.
Paul, should we resist when the guard comes for us?
They still whisper 'traitor' when you are not near, Paul. I do not - but the guard at the gate does.
I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes.
They spit the name 'Christian' at us like a curse, Paul - yet the believers wear it like armor.
It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me, and the life I live I live by faith in the Son of God.
The jailer draws his sword, Paul - he means to end his own life rather than face his commander's wrath!
Do not harm yourself! Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved - you and your household.
The proconsul Gallio dismissed the charges against us today, but the synagogue leaders will not forget it.
Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
The theater is packed with twenty-four thousand voices, Paul. We cannot reason with a riot.
None of these things move me, and I count my life worth nothing, so that I may finish the race and complete the task the Lord has given me.
(He steadies the frightened believers) No more fear among us - the Lord stood by me and gave me strength.
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness.
